text: REJECT: `ClassifyNextFile` collapses the three independent flags into one exclusive enum, so a file that is both a Next.js route/API file and starts with `"use server"` used to have `isActions == true` but now has it false, which changes behaviour wherever the rest of `Next` reads `isActions`. The rest of the method isn't in the diff, so I couldn't check that, or whether it still reads the removed `isRouteFile`, `isApiRoute` or `inApp` locals, which would break the build.
